english.title: Attempt to obtain property by deception
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to dishonestly obtain from **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..),

(A)_[to the value of **(..SPECIFY VALUE..)]_
(B)_[of a value unknown]_

with the intention of permanently depriving **(..SPECIFY THE ACTUAL LOSER - THE OWNER..) thereof by deception namely by falsely representing that **(..SPECIFY THE MANNER OF THE DECEPTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to dishonestly
obtain property by deception
with the intention of permanently depriving a person
thereof by deception by a false representation

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
